BiblicalUsage: The wainscot is the cedar panelling that covers the inside of the temple, from floor to ceiling. Solomon builds the house with cedar within, and the panelling hides the stone behind beauty. The word appears once, in the building of the house of God.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the cedar panelling shows that God is honoured by beauty in His house, and nothing in it is left bare.
